description:
Turn ACTION: lines in notes and logs into TASK: anchors, then list, inspect and change those anchors in place. The note and log lines are the only store; there is no backend.

Subcommands:
  ingest [--dry-run] [--quiet] — rewrite every ACTION: line under threads/<Kind>/<Name>/notes/ and threads/<Kind>/<Name>/logs/ as a TASK: anchor with a new 8-char uuid (bare `tasks` does the same)
  add THREAD TEXT [--due DATE] [--scheduled DATE] [--priority P] [--depends UUID] — append an ACTION entry to buffer.md (same as `buffer add-action`)
  done UUID — mark complete: TASK becomes DONE, stamped end:<today>
  set-description UUID TEXT — replace the task body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — replace the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set the due date
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set the scheduled date
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set the priority; writes [#X] in the visible text
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — make UUID wait on DEP_UUID
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a dependency
  list [--priority P] [--thread T] [--assignee A] [--overdue] [--json] — pending tasks grouped by thread A-Z, then sorted by priority, due and entry
  next — top 5 pending tasks by priority, due and entry
  show UUID — full detail of one task

Args:
  UUID: the task uuid from `tasks list`; any unique prefix works. For rm-depends, DEP_UUID is any prefix that matches one of this task's dependencies.
  THREAD: thread label 'Kind/Name', e.g. Projects/SGB.
  TEXT (add): '(Assignee) description' or just 'description'.
  PERSON: a name with a file at people/<Name>.md; a leading 'people/' is allowed.
  DATE: YYYY-MM-DD.
  PRIORITY: H, M or L.

Flags:
  ingest (also accepted before the subcommand):
    --dry-run   show what would be ingested; write nothing
    --quiet     no per-action output
  add:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD, --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8   8-char uuid of another task; repeatable
  list:
    --priority H|M|L   only this priority
    --thread Kind/Name   only tasks whose source note carries this thread
    --assignee NAME   only tasks assigned to this person
    --overdue   only tasks with a due date before today
    --json   JSON output

Examples:
  ["list", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-06-15"]

Notes:
  `add` only queues an ACTION in buffer.md. It gets no uuid and does not show in list until `buffer flush` runs.
  ingest and every set-*/done/add-depends/rm-depends subcommand rewrites note and log files in place. Never edit TASK:/DONE: lines by hand.
  Exit 1: empty uuid prefix, no task matches the prefix, bad date format, empty description, assignee has no people/<Name>.md, or a task set to depend on itself.
